s.note: Jenny's sandwich: you don't wanna know. Turkey, bacon, avocado and secret sauce.
s.how: Fry the bacon until crisp and toast the bread. Stir the mayo with the sriracha and relish for the secret sauce. Build triple-deckers: sauce, turkey and lettuce, then toast, then bacon, avocado and tomato. Pin with toothpicks and cut each into 4 triangles.

s.n: Let off some steam pork buns
s.note: Steamed bao, sticky pork belly, cucumber. Bennett faked his own death.
s.how: Brown the pork belly all over in a heavy pot. Add the soy, hoisin, sugar, garlic, ginger and water, cover and simmer gently until tender. Lift out the pork, reduce the liquid to a sticky glaze and slice the pork thickly into it. Toss the cucumber with the rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar, and steam the buns. Fill the buns with pork, cucumber, peanuts and coriander.

m.note: Citrus garlic chicken, black beans and rice. Arius wants to lead a coup.
m.how: Mix the citrus juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, oil and salt and marinate the chicken for at least 2 hours. Roast the chicken at 200C, skin side up, until crisp and cooked through, basting with the marinade. Soften the onion and capsicum, add the beans with their liquid and simmer until thick. Cook the rice and serve with the chicken, beans and coriander.

m.n: Green Berets for breakfast huevos rancheros
m.note: Fried eggs, salsa roja, beans, green chilli. Served motel style.
m.how: Soften the onion and garlic in a little oil, add the tomatoes and chipotle and simmer to a thick salsa. Warm the beans and fry the tortillas in a little oil until just crisp at the edges. Fry the eggs sunny side up in the rest of the oil. Spread beans on the tortillas, add the eggs and spoon the salsa round, then top with feta, green chilli and avocado.

w.n: I let him go tres leches
w.note: Milk-soaked sponge, coconut cream, lime. Cindy tails Sully to the mall.
w.how: Beat the yolks with 150g sugar until pale, then stir in the milk and fold in the flour. Whisk the whites with the rest of the sugar to soft peaks and fold through. Bake in a lined 20 by 30cm tin at 175C until springy. Prick the warm cake all over and pour over the condensed milk, evaporated milk and coconut cream, mixed. Chill overnight. Whip the cream and spread over, then finish with lime zest and coconut.

d.n: Fly or die seaplane rum punch
d.note: Dark rum, pineapple, lime, nutmeg. Next stop, Arius's island.
d.how: Stir the rum, pineapple, lime and grenadine in a jug. Pour into 4 tall glasses of ice and top with soda. Grate a little nutmeg over each.
